notes.title: Patch 1.0.10: Added "Inverted Y-Axis" setting.
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Added the "Inverted Y-Axis" setting as people mentioned it was something they would like added.

Thank you so much for the suggestions you guys give me on Discord and on Steam Discussions.
It helps me make a game that is more accessible and better for everyone!

Here's the full patch notes:

 Added Inverted Y-Axis Setting to Settings Panel.
 Prevent game from loading a save file icon that doesn't exist for the save file.
 Fixed the achievement, "TOO....MUCH...POWER!!!" not unlocking when generating the required power.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9: Potential fix for inventory bug.
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

May of solved is this time, I'm pretty sure it was to do with the "drag and drop" feature I added in a previous patch.

I also limited the amount of an item the game calculates to improve performance if you tend to have a lot of items in your inventory.

Here's the full patch notes:

 Added crafting limit to 32 items at once.
 Removed inventory "drag and drop" feature.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8: Crafting Bug I saw.
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

Fix crafting bug with crafting event not triggering next event if it was unable to complete.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7: Potentially fix elusive inventory bug and a tweak to Conveyor Belts
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Potential fix for the inventory bug that some people have been reporting. It's quite the problem and it's VERY hard to reproduce and work out what exactly is causing it.

While I was bug-hunting, I saw a Conveyor Belt connection that shouldn't happen so fixed that quickly.

Here's the full patch notes:

 Potential fix for the elusive inventory bug.
 Fixed Conveyor Belt connecting to a Conveyor Belt below that wasn't facing the same direction as it.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6: Save Game Single Threaded Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

A person has reported having VERY strange inventory behaviour that I cannot for the life of me replicate.
I have a hunch its to do with when the game saves as that is multi-threaded and could cause some issues. Although I myself haven't had any issues with it so far.

Here's the complete patch notes. There's an additional tidbit too. :) Thanks again!


 Saving game is now only single-threaded to hopefully fix a bug causing inventory to be stuffed.
 Mineral Extractor now stops animating when it doesn't have anymore minerals to extract after rotating.
 Save game notification added so people know when the game is saved.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5: Another Another drag and drop fluidity hotfix...
notes.notes:
Hi again!
Drag and drop truly is the bane of my existence. Who would've thought.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4: Another drag and drop fluidity hotfix.
notes.notes:
Hi guys, again. LOL.

Spotted another inconsistency with the drag and drop. :( Should have caught them all now...

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3: Drag and Drop fluidity.
notes.notes:
Hi again!
I noticed the 'drag-and-drop' behaviour for inventory was a bit off and it was annoying me so I just quickly adjusted it slightly just for this patch. Feels a bit weird to dedicate an entire patch to only one small change but whatever!


 Adjusted 'drag-and-drop' inventory behaviour slightly to be more fluid.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2: QoL, Tutorial Improvements, Inventory swapping fix and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
Back with another bunch of small updates. Main focus was fixing the bug that 'drag and dropping' introduced in the previous patch. Hopefully no bugs are introduced with this patch but if they are, let me know on the Discord which you can find in-game!


 Fixed "drag and dropping" from inventory slots interfering with "swapping items".
 Vertical sync enabled by default.
 Added Camera Sensitivity Setting.
 Turned production tab sorting algorithm from unstable to stable. Hopefully prevent production items from inconsistently sorting.
 Reduced volume and equalized most of the sounds.
 Added "block break particles" to title_screen to cache the shader.
 Tutorial changes.
 Item information changes. 
 Coal fuel time buff (20 seconds > 25 seconds), Wooden Planks nerfed (7.5 seconds > 5 seconds) and Oak Log fuel time nerf (15 seconds > 10 seconds) .
 Steam Power Generator when held in the hand is now bigger to bring it in line with the scale of other items held.
 Added being able to add a custom world seed.
 Added portal 'whoosh' sound when you first load into a new game.
 Made player icon more visible in the map panel.
 Added a "Tutorial Complete" panel to give the player a direction to go towards when finishing the tutorial.
 Whenever you load a normal save game that has completed the tutorial, you will now be granted the achievement if not already obtained.
 Default Window Size is now your maximum window size.
 Added warning to player if Steam isn't open.

notes.title: Patch: 1.0.1: Quality of Life + Fixed a couple of crashes.
notes.notes:
Hi guys! Ignore the previous "Small Update" I released I forgot to add the rest of the update to it!

Here's the full changes. Remember you can join the Discord via the link in-game and join the discussion to help improve the game further!


 GUI Scale Option.
 Inventory buttons now support dragging an item and dropping an item into another inventory slot. (Holding left click then releasing left click over another button)
 Added GUI Scaling Keybinds (Increase and Decrease).
 Fixed a potential crash caused by tutorial panels accessing a keybind that has no assigned event.
 Jump cooldown added  to prevent "jump launching" bug.
 Fixed Infused Inserters not working.
